title: ReefHub, Auto Block, Auto Dash, Auto Hit, & More!
features:
• Skill Aimbot: Automatically aims your skills directly at the target.
• Aimbot FOV: Adjustable field of view for target detection.
• Reach: Increases your attack range by expanding enemy hitboxes.
• Kill Steal: Automatically finishes off low-health opponents.
• Acrobatic Jump: Performs mid-air flips enhanced with neon trail effects.
• AFK Safe Zone: Teleports you to a safe sky platform equipped with Anti-AFK protection.
• FPS Boost: Optimizes map textures and lighting to improve performance.
• ESP: Displays players and their health bars through walls (Wallhack).
• Kill Aura: Automatically attacks anyone within range (features Legit and God Mode).
• Anti-Combo Escape: Automatically teleports you away when caught in an enemy combo.
• Speed Hack: Customizable movement and walking speed.
• Fly & Noclip: Flight mode with custom trail effects and the ability to pass through walls.
• Infinite Jump: Allows you to jump endlessly while mid-air.
• Revenge TP: Automatically teleports you to the player who just killed you.
• Steal Look: Copies the exact outfit and avatar configuration of the targeted player.
• Troll Suite: Includes Spinbot (Mevlana), Sit on Head, Orbit Target, and Fling.
• Theme System: Allows customizing the menu UI appearance (Windows 11, Hacker, Retro 98, etc.).
